versions.changelog: Security fix (T09): locally-signed transactions now verify the node-returned payload byte-exactly binds to the approved transfer (recipient, amount, fee, memo, sender, vk) before signing — a hostile/impersonated node can no longer obtain a signature over a different transfer
v1.2.0: estimate-fee, netinfo, watch, supply, mine --wait, wallet-backup/restore, validate, explorer-backed history, hardened restore (no extractall), state-dir isolation
